title: llmstance
blurb: enter a Bluesky handle and pick a scope — just their posts, their followers, their following, or their entire network — and it labels every post Pro-LLM, Anti-LLM, or Unclear with a keyword heuristic (no model in the loop), then tallies the overall LLM stance with receipts for the strongest posts on each side. asked for by fromthewestmeadow.com.
